home.eyebrow: PANW|IDIRA Conjur · External Secrets Operator · Kubernetes
home.title: Zero-Trust
home.subtitle: A live demo where every database credential is fetched dynamically from Conjur Cloud via the External Secrets Operator — no hardcoded passwords, no .env file, no secret baked in the image.

secrets_info.title: How Secrets Flow
secrets_info.subtitle: Zero credentials in code — delivered by ESO → Conjur at runtime
secrets_info.step1: ClusterSecretStore — ESO authenticates with Conjur Cloud via authn-jwt/eks-latam using the pod's Kubernetes service account JWT
secrets_info.step2: ExternalSecret maps Conjur paths to a K8s Secret:
secrets_info.step4: Deployment mounts the secret as environment variables via envFrom.secretRef
secrets_info.step5: App reads DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASS from env — no Conjur SDK, no file reads
